title: Fallout Adder on Rate Lock Commitment Relocks for Files Without a Scheduled Closing
content:
**Rate Lock Commitment relocks — fallout adder.** A relocked lock on a file with no closing scheduled carries a fallout adder. The adder is added to the relocked price, which is rounded to three decimal places.

The basis is the status of the **Mortgage Loan File**, and whether a closing is scheduled on it in **Closing and Funding**. A closing is scheduled when its closing status is scheduled or docs out.

**Rule.**

- When no closing is scheduled on the loan file and the file is still in processing, underwriting, conditional approval or suspense, the open-file fallout adder of **0.25** points is added.
- When no closing is scheduled and the file is clear to close, the cleared-file fallout adder of **0.125** points is added.
- Otherwise none is added.

| Closing scheduled (scheduled or docs out) | Loan file status | Adder (points) |
|---|---|---|
| No | Processing, underwriting, conditionally approved or suspended | 0.25 |
| No | Clear to close | 0.125 |
| No | Any other status | 0 |
| Yes | Any | 0 |

*Hypothetical case:* a conditionally approved file whose closing reads docs out carries no fallout adder. If its closing had been cancelled, it would carry 0.25 points.
